source: RFC 0014 R2 (mixed-version compatibility; the maintainer's direction of 2026-11-24, “按这个方向”); the compatibility review of 2026-11-24 (F2, CE-3, CE-5)
statement: Every member of the CoSec-Identity header has a recorded meaning when absent (IdentityMembers in cosec-document, whose paths the cosec-identity format descriptor names member for member): a required member's absence is refused (400, or 401 for auth.exp); `memberships` absent is not stated, which a host that decides with policies on the identity refuses and a service that only trusts the gateway reads as the decided space's roles with no attachment; `auth.capped` absent is false, `auth.session` none, `auth.iat` unknown (which a revocation of the principal's tokens takes as revoked), and `claims` empty. A member whose being ignored would widen what a reader decides (today `memberships`, `auth.capped` and `claims`) is never added as one an older reader may ignore. A hop never states a member it did not receive: HttpControlService's relay of a request's caller writes `memberships` only when the identity it relays stated them, and leaves the member out otherwise, so a host that decides on the identity refuses that caller as it would refuse the header; the control plane's in-process facade refuses such a caller alike, as malformed (400 invalid-request), before the control plane is asked (CTL-77). Every other member the relay was forwarded arrives as it was.
guards: document:IdentityMembersTest#the descriptor names exactly the recorded members, and a required one is one whose absence is refused - IDN-42
document:IdentityMembersTest#a member recorded as refused when absent does not read without it - IDN-42
document:IdentityMembersTest#each optional member reads its absence as recorded - IDN-42
document:IdentityMembersTest#the members whose being ignored would widen what a reader decides are the memberships, the cap and the claims - IDN-42
runtime:IdentityRelayTest#memberships the service was not forwarded are not relayed, and the deciding host refuses the caller - IDN-42
runtime:IdentityRelayTest#memberships the service was forwarded are relayed as they were, and decide at the host - IDN-42
runtime:IdentityRelayTest#empty memberships are stated memberships, and are relayed as stated - IDN-42
runtime:IdentityRelayTest#every other member the service was forwarded is relayed as it was - IDN-42
control-http:HttpControlServiceTest#a request's caller's memberships are relayed as they were forwarded - IDN-42
control:ControlServiceTest#a caller forwarded without memberships is refused before the control plane is asked - IDN-42
spring-boot:ControlServiceParityTest#a caller forwarded without memberships is refused alike through both implementations - IDN-42
